title: Signature: Compatibility time machine
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): before upgrading, the new version is tested against recorded historical workloads: real requests captured from production, replayed verbatim. If the new version handles history correctly, it earns the upgrade. History is the hardest test suite to fake. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers replaying recorded production workloads.
demo:

CFG = {1: 50, 2: 200, 3: 1000}

print("replayed:", N, "| mismatches:", mismatch, "| upgrade:", "APPROVED" if mismatch == 0 else "HELD")

title: Signature: Version pinning ledger
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every deployment records its exact pinned versions in an append-only ledger. 'It worked in staging' becomes verifiable: the ledger proves staging and production ran identical versions. Unpinned deployments are rejected by policy. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers recording exact versions per deployment.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"tool": "1.4.2", "lib": "2.0.1"}, 2: {"tool": "1.4.2", "lib": "2.0.1", "db": "3.1.0"}, 3: {"tool": "1.4.2", "lib": "2.0.1", "db": "3.1.0", "os": "5.0"}}
pinned = CFG[LEVEL]
staging = dict(pinned)
prod = dict(pinned); prod["lib"] = "2.0.2"  # drift!
parity = staging == prod
print("pinned:", pinned, "| staging==prod:", parity, "| policy:", "REJECT drift" if not parity else "ok")
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Dual-version shadowing
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the old and new versions run side by side on live traffic; the old version serves, the new version shadows. Outputs are compared in real time, and divergences are logged with full context. Shadowing catches incompatibilities that test suites miss. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers running old and new versions side by side.

print("shadowed requests:", N, "| divergences:", diverged, "| ship:", "NO" if diverged else "YES")

title: Signature: Safe-upgrade certificate
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): an upgrade ships only with a certificate: compatibility checks passed, canary healthy, blast radius reviewed, rollback tested.
